name: glarepilot
description: Long-distance driving companion with time-aware forecast weather and sun-glare prediction.

scripts.deploy:cloudflare: echo 'Cloudflare deploy is deferred; set CF_BRANCH explicitly to deploy a preview branch' && test -n "$CF_BRANCH" && npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.45.0 pages deploy dist --project-name glarepilot --branch "$CF_BRANCH"
